pr_title: Add live brokerage DataQueueHandler support to PaperBrokerage
pr_body:
#### Description
This change allows local LEAN users to use the `GDAXDataQueueHandler` with the `PaperBrokerage`.

#### Related Issue
Closes #2103 

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Local testing with the `paper-gdax` configuration in #2103

issue_context.title: GDAX paper trading throws error
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Expect paper trading environment to launch. I have made the relevant updates in config.json, and created the paper-gdax environment, but unfortunately I cannot get a GDAX paper environment to work.

#### Actual Behavior

Error:

ERROR:: Algorithm.Initialize() Error: Cannot create an instance of type 'QuantConnect.Brokerages.GDAX.GDAXDataQueueHandler' because a constructor could not be selected for construction. Ensure that the type either has a default constructor, or a single constructor marked with the 'System.ComponentModel.Composition.ImportingConstructorAttribute'.

#### Potential Solution


#### Reproducing the Problem
I have the following entry in config.json:

   "paper-gdax": {

      "live-mode": true,

      // real brokerage implementations require the BrokerageTransactionHandler
      "live-mode-brokerage": "PaperBrokerage",

      "data-queue-handler": "GDAXDataQueueHandler",
      "setup-handler": "QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.Setup.BrokerageSetupHandler",
      "result-handler": "QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.Results.LiveTradingResultHandler",
      "data-feed-handler": "QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.DataFeeds.LiveTradingDataFeed",
      "real-time-handler": "QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.RealTime.LiveTradingRealTimeHandler",
      "transaction-handler": "QuantConnect.Lean.Engine.TransactionHandlers.BacktestingTransactionHandler",
      "history-provider": "BrokerageHistoryProvider"
    },


#### System Information
WIndows 10, Visual Studio Community 2017

#### Checklist

- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
<!--- Required for Bugs, feature request can delete the line below. -->
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments: Should we add this attribute to any other types that follow this pattern?

I quickly tested this attribute with the other brokerages and "it just works" :)
So we can enable local paper trading with data from FXCM, Oanda and IB in addition to GDAX which was the primary target of this PR.
Should we also add these 4 new paper configurations in config.json?
